name: VisaDocumentReadinessTracker
tagline: Every traveller travel-ready: passports, visas, ETAs and documents tracked to the deadline.
description: A complete group-travel document readiness app for tour operators, DMCs, MICE and corporate travel teams: per-traveller entry requirement, required-document checklists, passport validity and blank-page rules, apply-by deadlines from departure dates, a status board, a deadline calendar and per-trip go/no-go readiness – in one Power Apps component for canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: 8 clickable KPIs and readiness by trip
Passport validity (N months after return) and blank-page rules
Deadlines from processing days per requirement
Rule-checked status workflow with reasons and undo
Bulk request documents with email-ready payload
